caseName: Land O'Lakes Dairy Co. v. County of Wadena
caseNameFull: Land O'Lakes Dairy Co. v. County of Wadena
attorneys: Michael J. Doherty and Harold Jordan for appellant. J. A. A. Burnquist, Attorney General of Minnesota, Geo. B. Sjoselius, Deputy Attorney General, and Chas. P. Stone, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. S. R. A., Inc. v. Minnesota, 327 U. S. 558; Oklahoma Tax Comm’n v. Texas Co., 336 U. S. 342.
